{{Otheruses|Brotherhood}}
The '''Brotherhood badge''' was an identification used by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]] as of [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. It was a five-sided [[Color/Legends|red]] shape crossed with black lines, that the pirates wore in the left side of their collars.<ref name="Into the Storm Clouds">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref>
